primary_metric: paired mean normalized weighted score: full-system minus vanilla
evaluation_policy: Do not modify tasks, reference requirements, weights, rubric, judge protocol, router prompt, or skill context after inspecting scored results from task-gain-v1.
All five variants use the same generation model and user prompt; routed variants reuse one frozen catalog-single route per task.
Judge sees anonymous A-E answers with deterministic per-task shuffling.
If judge_model equals generation model, record that limitation and optionally replicate with an independent judge later.
Source-evidence tasks use only local corpus retrieval; modern application tasks do not receive irrelevant source retrieval.
